overloadMerges.note: The draft defaulted 'recordArray' to direction:in based on syntax position, but the doc arrow ('←') marks it as filled in by the command with the resulting record numbers, not read.

params.name: recordArray
params.description: Filled in with the (absolute) record numbers in selection; element 0 is always initialized to -1.

params.name: selection
params.description: Name of the named selection to use; the current selection of aTable is used if omitted.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills an array with the absolute record numbers of a named selection, or the current selection of aTable if none is given.
